name: Princess guest profile - daily export to Couchbase landing zone
description: Real-Time CDP dataset export: one JSON Lines file set per day, consumed by the Princess guest-app backend loader.
notes: The backend loader (backend/app/loader.py) treats a partition as complete when _SUCCESS is present.
Guests sailing within 10 days are also published to the AOM Knowledge Base; the rest stay in Couchbase only.
adobe/generate_mock_export.py produces the same layout for environments without an AEP sandbox.
